list.name: contratista
list.label: Contratista
list.query: SELECT id as __value, razon_social as __text FROM contratistas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true ORDER BY razon_social

list.name: area
list.label: Área
list.query: SELECT id as __value, nombre as __text FROM areas_mirror WHERE estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) ORDER BY nombre

targets.rawSql: SELECT c.razon_social AS contratista, COUNT(e.id) AS total FROM expedientes e JOIN contratistas_mirror c ON e.contratista_id = c.id LEFT JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) GROUP BY c.razon_social ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT c.razon_social AS contratista, AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(e.fecha_termino, now()) - e.fecha_creacion)) / 86400) AS promedio_dias FROM expedientes e JOIN contratistas_mirror c ON e.contratista_id = c.id LEFT JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) AND e.fecha_termino IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.razon_social ORDER BY promedio_dias

SELECT am.nombre AS area, COUNT(d.id) AS total FROM documentos d JOIN expedientes e ON d.expediente_id = e.id JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id JOIN areas_mirror am ON p.area_id = am.id WHERE d.estado_activo = true AND e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) GROUP BY am.nombre ORDER BY total DESC

SELECT am.nombre AS area, ROUND(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ep.tipo_etapa = 'final' OR ep.es_final = true)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) AS aprobacion_pct FROM expedientes e JOIN procesos p ON e.proceso_id = p.id JOIN areas_mirror am ON p.area_id = am.id LEFT JOIN etapas_proceso ep ON e.etapa_actual_id = ep.id WHERE e.estado_activo = true AND (0 IN (${area:csv}) OR p.area_id IN (${area:csv})) AND (0 IN (${contratista:csv}) OR e.contratista_id IN (${contratista:csv})) GROUP BY am.nombre ORDER BY aprobacion_pct DESC
